verdict: Installed qwen3.8:27b-mlx can read these scan crops and correct OCR; no model download needed for this feasibility result. Selective source-assisted review is viable to investigate, not production proven.

review.root: Compared source crop visually: printed660; full Moorhead petition ends labor.; next Stevens petition excluded. All six JSON-mode statuses/transcriptions match frozen expectations.
review.independent_luna: Read-only review_store independently inspected cached scans and saved outputs; confirms660 on both damaged strings, unchanged clean control, exact petition, no-image/wrong-image abstentions. AI review, not new human grading.
review.confidence: Both abstentions self-report high. This may mean confidence in abstaining; never treat confidence alone as confidence in transcription correctness.
review.format: Schema-constrained batch had3truncated replies; JSON mode plus explicit prompt schema had6valid. Two protocol changes and warm model mean no isolated engine-cause or speed claim.

limits: One number and one petition, not representative OCR accuracy; repeated related controls are not independent corpus samples.
No degraded-image/ambiguous-digit control, names, difficult layouts, multiple pages or all-five-part vision coverage.
No GPT comparison, model download, new image fetch, canonical edit or accepted correction ledger entry.
Current POC checks shape and source evidence diagnostically; production patch/source validation, routing thresholds, human review and wider evaluation remain required.
Image-context text outside paragraph box cannot automatically be inserted without validated source/span/boundary mapping.
next: Complete queued S0 remaining-part/edge registration, then freeze a few distinct real uncertainty cases with genuinely unreadable controls and compare raw-text vs scan-assisted outcomes before proposing routing/acceptance thresholds. Human H1/H2/H5 checkpoints persist.
